data.name: Vimalraj
data.gender_notes: Vimalraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is free from all impurities and vices, and is a just and virtuous ruler. The name Vimalraj carries the meaning “Pure King” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vimalraj usually hope their child will grow to embody pure king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a soul that is pure and radiant, and is destined to rule with wisdom and compassion.
data.etymology: Vimalraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure King.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vimalraj total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Vimalraj" carries the prestigious legacy of an ideal king who embodies the virtues of purity, righteousness, and just governance. Such a ruler was revered in ancient Hindu society, and his name continues to inspire respect and admiration. The name symbolizes the values of a strong and noble leader, who sets an example for his subjects to follow.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Vimalraj" lies in its association with the ultimate quest for inner purity. The name signifies the pursuit of spiritual growth, freedom from attachments, and the striving towards a pure and virtuous life. It is a reminder that true power and worth come from within, and that a person's character is the foundation of their spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Vimalraj: Pure King. A name signifying a soul free from impurities, ruling over its own inner divine kingdom.

vedic_reference.note: The name Vimal is mentioned in the Rigveda (10.131.5) and the Mahabharata (Anushasana Parva 127.11). The name Raj is a common title for various deities and rulers in Hindu mythology and history.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Vimalraj was a Chola king who ruled from 1054 to 1070 AD The name Vimalraj carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Vimalraj continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Radha Vimalraj, a teacher in Kathmandu, Nepal, shares that their name Vimalraj meaning "Pure King" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
